description: This file defines the TileView class, which is a custom Android View designed to handle and display a grid of drawable tiles, typically used in grid-based games like Snake. It manages tile loading, rendering, and grid updates.

classes.name: TileView
classes.description: A custom view for rendering a grid of drawable tiles, supporting dynamic loading and updating of tiles.

methods.name: clearTiles
methods.description: Resets all tiles to 0 (empty) in the grid.

methods.name: loadTile
methods.description: Loads a Drawable as a bitmap into the tile array at a specified key.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the visible tiles onto the canvas.

methods.name: resetTiles
methods.description: Initializes the tile bitmap array with a specified size.

methods.name: setTile
methods.description: Sets a specific tile index at a particular x, y position in the grid.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts tile grid dimensions and offsets when the view size changes.
